result.title: Adaptive Distance Detection and Adaptive Instance Segmentation
result.comment: This is the paper from my Bachelor's degree in University of Birmingham
result.summary: This paper is about object detection model and semantic segmentation model in an FPS game Counter Strike: Condition Zero to detect enemies. Semantic segmentation is pixel-wise detection algorithm. We customized the architecture for semantic segmentation. We used YOLOv5s to train object detection model. After training, the inference time of semantic segmentation was compared to object detection. It was observed that object detection was slightly faster and semantic segmentation is slower but better at detecting the exact shape of the object. However, we found out that this slight difference of inference can grow exponentially if the both models get more complex. To solve this, we propose a novel approach called Adaptive distance detection which combines both algorithms. We will also introduce Adaptive instance segmentation to combine semantic segmentation and panoptic segmentation.

AI.brief_summary: 该本科工作在第一人称射击游戏 Counter Strike: Condition Zero 中用 YOLOv5s 做敌人检测、并定制语义分割架构，比较两者推理速度与形状检测精度，提出融合两者的「自适应距离检测」与「自适应实例分割」设想。
AI.relevance_reason: 属于游戏场景下的检测／分割应用与速度对比，不涉及 VLM 的 latent 推理状态、证据筛选、停止决策或训练监督，未提供可供借鉴的状态或决策层面的具体线索，故排除。
